fields.title: Steady thermal boundary versus actual operation
fields.finding: Zenith sun, fixed sky/ground temperatures and 2 m/s flow define two equilibria. The optimistic weather changes buoyancy and pressure but not the thermal boundary.
fields.needed: Specify joint sunlight, wind direction/speed, ambient/sky/ground histories, thermal inertia, precipitation and allowed operating states.
